name: Aruba

findings.local_actor: SETAR N.V. (Aruba's leading, state-owned telecom operator)
findings.summary: SETAR chose Nokia for a phased, island-wide end-to-end 5G transformation: RAN upgrades with AirScale and centralised RAN, a virtualised EPC, data-management modernisation and massive MIMO at first 5G sites. Nokia already ran SETAR's island-wide 4.5G Pro network.
findings.analyst_inference: Equipment vendor rule: Nokia supplies RAN and core, so pole third. Tier 3 as a vendor selection/deal with named counterparty; value undisclosed; 5G rollout completion not confirmed this run. Pre-2020 and still_current not confirmed. Converge Digest appears to echo the Nokia release, so not counted as independent; single opened S1, hence medium. SETAR state ownership is background knowledge, not stated in the opened sources.

findings.local_actor: SETAR N.V. (Aruba landing partner); CELIA consortium with Orange, Telxius and APUA
findings.builder: Alcatel Submarine Networks (end-to-end supplier); Orange Marine (marine deployment)
findings.summary: The CELIA consortium of SETAR, Orange, Telxius and APUA named ASN end-to-end supplier for a roughly 3,700 km cable linking Aruba, Martinique, Antigua, Puerto Rico and Boca Raton, Florida, targeted for service in Q3 2027.
findings.analyst_inference: Equipment vendor rule: ASN (French) supplies the cable, so pole third; Telxius (Spain) to provide NOC monitoring. Tier 3: supplier contract reported by SubTel Forum, though Capacity does not state a signed contract. Both opened reports relay the same consortium announcement, so not treated as independent; no S1 opened. Not yet operational.

findings.local_actor: Korps Politie Aruba (Aruba Police Force) Operation Command Center
findings.summary: Aruba police opened an Operation Command Center combining dispatch and radar monitoring, with real-time feeds from 258 cameras covering the high-rise hotel area, San Nicolas Main Street and 40 other locations. No vendor is named.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: no camera, VMS or analytics vendor named, so controller unknown; no AI analytics stated. Second government page (Jan 2026) adds 43 cameras on Caya Grandi, Oranjestad, also without vendor; same publisher, so not independent corroboration. Tier 5 as an operational island-wide system.

facilities.null_reason: two searches returned only Aruba S.p.A. (Italian hosting firm) results; no large data-centre or AI-campus project in Aruba found

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchase or deployment surfaced in other searches

models.null_reason: one search found only that the ministry began drafting a national AI strategy (July 2026) naming no model provider; no frontier-provider partnership or sovereign model found
